desc:
⚽Build Your Dream Soccer Team And Dominate The Drafting!
💶1v1 Other Players Or Bots In A Bidding Battle While Managing Your Budget
🏆Win Money And Build Your Dream Soccer Team
🏟️With Your Dream Team Go Against Other Players With Your Team Choice!
📅Predict Schedules From 7 Leagues And See If You're Right!

In this game, you bid draft 11 players on a soccer field with over 1700 players and 8 different leagues. All 11 positions are on the field and after the draft both players go head to head in a full on match. Build your dream soccer team and go against other players or bots. You get to join a league and pick your team of choice, all playoffs rules and amount of games are different for each league. 

Favorite The Game For Weekly Updates! ⭐
